items.title: What is the average group size?
items.description: Our small-group expeditions are capped at 12 travelers to ensure intimacy and access to boutique accommodations.

items.title: Are flights included in the price?
items.description: Prices typically cover all land arrangements, internal flights, and activities. International airfare can be added by our concierge.

items.title: What is your cancellation policy?
items.description: We offer flexible booking with full refunds up to 60 days before departure, or lifetime deposits for future trips.

items.title: Do you cater to specific dietary needs?
items.description: Absolutely. Our local guides and partners are briefed on all dietary requirements well in advance of your arrival.
